Add the Swedish Standing Committee of Ways and Means (Bevillningsutskottet, 1809-1970) as the first instance of the new Committee kind: the Age of Liberty taxation deputation and the committee first named at the Riksdag of 1800, the 1810 Act's twelve members per estate, the post-1866 bicameral 20 elected half by each chamber, the section 37 composition and section 40 duty to calculate revenue and propose the balance, the initiative right confined to taxation, the two divisions, the mid-century fiscal-year tax report, and the 1970 replacement by the Committee on Taxation.

Add KTH Royal Institute of Technology as the state constitution of the University kind: Polhem's Laboratorium Mechanicum of 1697 and the School of Mechanics of 1798 behind the Technological Institute ordered by Charles XIV John in 1825 and opened on 6 June 1827 on the polytechnic model, the Schwartz conflict and Akerman's reorganisation, the 1867 scientific reform and the 1877 renaming with architecture added, the civilingenjor title made legally protected in 1915 and the 1927 right to confer doctorates, the Lallerstedt campus of 1917, the R1 reactor critical in 1954 and decommissioned in 1970, the five schools of 2018, and the 2025 closure of the Kista and Sodertalje campuses.

Add Alexis de Tocqueville as a persona: the Norman count and great-grandson of Malesherbes who made democracy an object of observation, the 1831 American journey with Beaumont and the penitentiary report behind Democracy in America, the thirteen years as deputy for Valognes, the 1848 constitution commission, his months as foreign minister in 1849, and the late history of the Old Regime; the decomposition keeps his contradictions rather than resolving them, recording the abolitionism and free trade alongside his support for the colonisation of Algeria and his approval of the state of siege and the 1849 laws restricting clubs and the press.

Fill the Claude-Frederic Bastiat stub: the Sengresse estate at Mugron and the Landes wine crisis he first wrote about in Le fisc et la vigne, the magistracy and the Conseil general, the free-trade association of 1846 and Le Libre-Echange with Cobden, the 1848-49 assembly seats, the sophism and the petition as his instruments, the candlemakers and the broken window, The Law's definition of legal plunder and its test, the 1849-50 debate with Proudhon, and the death in Rome in 1850.

Add Opportunity Cost as a concept of decision theory: the value of the best alternative forgone, OC(a_i) = max over j != i of V(a_j), with its four well-definedness conditions (availability, exclusivity, comparable valuation, selection) and the five essential elements (scarcity, alternatives, exclusivity, selection, forgone value). The note separates the best-forgone rule from the sum of all rejected alternatives with the government-budget example (144 -> 120, net advantage 30), bounds the concept against explicit, accounting and sunk cost and against regret, reads it as ex ante (Buchanan: cost is displaced by choice), declares the valuation rather than assuming it, and records the two failures of operationalizability: the counterfactual is unobservable, and the alternative set is a modelling choice that widening can make arbitrarily expensive.

Add Nicotine as a substance of the molecular family: C10H14N2, a pyridine ring and a pyrrolidine ring joined by one bond with a methyl on the pyrrolidine nitrogen and a single stereocentre at C2', the natural (S)-enantiomer. The note carries the two precursors (nicotinic acid through the NAD route for the pyridine ring, ornithine through putrescine and the N-methyl-Delta1-pyrrolinium cation for the pyrrolidine) and the still-unsettled coupling between them, root synthesis and xylem transport with the grafting experiment that shows the plant is not its own target, antiherbivore neurotoxicity against Manduca sexta's counter-adaptations, alpha4-beta2 receptor affinity near 1 nM and dopaminergic reinforcement, and the attributes that fix the substance: the 8.1 and 3.4 pKa pair, membrane permeability, 247 C volatility and green tobacco sickness, optical activity, toxicity, teratogenicity, and the point the literature blurs -- nicotine is not classified as a carcinogen while the smoke carries the carcinogens, and the usual 60 mg lethal dose descends from nineteenth-century self-experiments.
